papers.title: Using hierarchical statistical learning models to model individual statistical learning
papers.reason: The study centrally uses a hierarchical Bayesian generative model to reproduce individual learning trajectories from human EEG, but the listening paradigm is passive and no frequency-domain or connectivity analysis is described.

papers.title: TinyCNNDeep: Lightweight Attention-Based CNN for EEG Classification of Eye States and Sleep Deprivation
papers.reason: The paper classifies sleep condition and eye state from human EEG using a CNN, but its central method is raw-segment image classification rather than an interactive task, eye tracking, or detailed frequency-domain or connectivity analysis.

papers.title: EyeBrain: Left and Right Brain Lateralization Activity Classification Through Pupil Diameter and Fixation Duration
papers.reason: Human eye tracking through pupil diameter and fixation duration is central to classifying cognitive activity, but no timed decision paradigm, EEG analysis, or cognitive process model is specified.

papers.title: Human Cognition in Machines: A Unified Perspective of World Models
papers.reason: The paper concerns cognitive capabilities and memory in machine world models rather than cognition measured in human participants.

papers.title: SABER: Spatial Attention, Brain, Extended Reality
papers.reason: Participants perform an interactive sequential VR object-striking task while oscillatory EEG activity is analyzed to reconstruct moment-by-moment spatial attention.

papers.title: Brian Intensify: An Adaptive Machine Learning Framework for Auditory EEG Stimulation and Cognitive Enhancement in FXS
papers.reason: The human FXS study centrally analyzes EEG spectral power and cross-frequency coupling under auditory entrainment, although the condition is passive and lacks eye tracking or cognitive process modelling.

papers.title: Towards Human-AI-Robot Collaboration and AI-Agent based Digital Twins for Parkinson's Disease Management: Review and Outlook
papers.reason: The review addresses multimodal human Parkinson's monitoring and cognitive care but does not itself implement an eligible behavioural task, eye-tracking analysis, frequency-domain EEG method, or generative cognitive model.

papers.title: Cross-Enhanced Multimodal Fusion of Eye-Tracking and Facial Features for Alzheimer's Disease Diagnosis
papers.reason: The study records and analyzes eye movements from patients with Alzheimer's disease and controls during an interactive visual memory-search task for multimodal clinical classification.

papers.title: IoT-Enabled Sleep Monitoring and Cognitive Assessment for Evaluating Teacher Well-Being
papers.reason: The human study combines passive smartwatch sleep measures with a self-report cognitive questionnaire but includes none of the specified interactive, eye-tracking, EEG, or cognitive-modelling methods.

papers.title: Meta-learning ecological priors from large language models explains human learning and decision making
papers.reason: The paper develops a meta-learned inference model of human cognition and validates its trial-level predictions across interactive learning and decision-making experiments.

papers.title: Benchmarking of EEG Analysis Techniques for Parkinson's Disease Diagnosis: A Comparison between Traditional ML Methods and Foundation DL Methods
papers.reason: The paper benchmarks classifiers on human oddball EEG for Parkinson's diagnosis but provides no qualifying frequency-domain or connectivity methodology and does not establish that participant decisions are central to the analysis.

papers.title: Perceptual multistability: a window for a multi-facet understanding of psychiatric disorders
papers.reason: The synthesis explicitly covers both human and non-human animal studies, so its study populations are not restricted to human participants.

papers.title: EPFL-Smart-Kitchen-30: Densely annotated cooking dataset with 3D kinematics to challenge video and language models
papers.reason: Human participants complete extended sequential cooking activities while synchronized eye gaze and action data are captured, although the paper primarily develops machine-learning benchmarks rather than cognitive assessment.

papers.title: Dementia classification from spontaneous speech using wrapper-based feature selection
papers.reason: The paper develops a human speech biomarker for dementia from a picture-description condition but contains no qualifying interactive decision task, eye tracking, EEG analysis, or cognitive process model.

papers.title: Human fields and their impact on brain waves A pilot study
papers.reason: The human pilot study centrally compares EEG power spectral density before and during an intervention, but it lacks an interactive cognitive task, eye tracking, connectivity analysis, or computational cognitive model.
